follow-up time: Until birth for those who conceived
exposure: Patients who conceived after MR-HIFU therapy (n=20)
cohort: 276 patients with uterine fibroids treated with MR-HIFU
finding: MRgFUS/MR-HIFU appears to be a viable minimally invasive treatment option for women with uterine fibroids who wish to conceive, as it doesn't seem to increase the risk of miscarriages or pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: Out of 11 patients who gave birth after MR-HIFU therapy, 63.64% (n=7) had a cesarean section.
